The IT department will perform routine server maintenance on Saturday from 1 AM to 5 AM.

During this time, access to internal applications may be temporarily unavailable.

For details, visit:

http://it-support.company.com/maintenance

We appreciate your understanding.

samples.subject: Quarterly Financial Report Submission Reminder
samples.body:
All department heads are reminded to submit their quarterly financial reports by the end of this week.

Please upload the finalized documents to the shared drive at:

http://files.company.com/reports

Contact finance@company.com for any assistance.

samples.subject: Quarterly Sales Report Submission Reminder
samples.body:
Attention Sales Department,

Please submit your quarterly sales reports by the end of this week.

Reports should be uploaded via the secure company portal:

http://reports.company.com/upload

Ensure all data is accurate and complete.

Thank you for your cooperation.

samples.subject: Monthly system maintenance scheduled - April 2024
samples.body:
Dear team,

Please be informed that the monthly system maintenance will take place on April 15th, 2024 from 02:00 AM to 04:00 AM UTC.

During this time, some services may be temporarily unavailable.

For details, visit:

http://intranet.company.com/maintenance

Thank you for your cooperation.

samples.subject: [Update] Meeting agenda and notes for next week
samples.body:
Hi team,

Please find attached the agenda for our upcoming meeting scheduled on Friday.
Make sure to review the topics and prepare your reports.

Let me know if you have any questions.

Thanks,

Alex

samples.subject: Meeting agenda for next week’s project discussion
samples.body:
Hi team,

Please find attached the agenda for our upcoming project discussion scheduled for next Monday.

Topics include:
- Project milestones
- Budget review
- Resource allocation

Let me know if you have any additional points to discuss.

Best regards,
Jane Doe
Project Manager

samples.subject: Weekly Team Meeting - Agenda and Notes
samples.body:
Hi Team,

Please find attached the agenda for this week's meeting scheduled on Thursday at 10 AM.

Topics include project updates, timelines, and upcoming milestones.

Looking forward to your participation.

Best,
Alex

---
This message is intended for internal communication only.
